course.title: Unit 3 Keep Fit【例句】
course.description: Section A How often do you do sport or exercise?

sentences.content: Can you name the sport in the photo?
sentences.english: Can you name the sport in the photo ?
sentences.chinese: 你能说出照片中的运动名称吗？

sentences.content: Is it a popular sport in China?
sentences.english: Is it a popular sport in China ?
sentences.chinese: 这在中国是一项流行的运动吗？

sentences.content: Do you like to do this sport?
sentences.english: Do you like to do this sport ?

sentences.content: How often do you play football?
sentences.english: How often do you play football ?

sentences.content: I play football three times a week.
sentences.english: I play football three times a week

sentences.content: You can practise with me if you like. Thanks!
sentences.english: You can practise with me if you like . Thanks !
sentences.chinese: 如果你愿意的话，可以和我一起练习。谢谢！

sentences.content: Yes. I usually play once or twice at weekends.
sentences.english: Yes . I usually play once or twice at weekends
sentences.chinese: 是的。我通常会在周末玩一两次。

sentences.content: Twice a week. Can I join your game this weekend?
sentences.english: Twice a week . Can I join your game this weekend ?
sentences.chinese: 每周两次。这周末我能加入你们的游戏吗？

sentences.content: Ask Han Lin. I think it’s his.
sentences.english: Ask Han Lin . I think it's his
sentences.chinese: 问问Han Lin。我觉得这是他的。

sentences.content: Oh, you’re right. It has “HL” on it.
sentences.english: Oh , you're right . It has " HL " on it
sentences.chinese: 哦，你说得对。上面确实有“HL”字样。

sentences.content: I never do. I don’t like it.
sentences.english: I never do . I don't like it
sentences.chinese: 我从不这样。我不喜欢这样。

sentences.content: How often do you play it?
sentences.english: How often do you play it ?

sentences.content: I play it three times a week, and sometimes more!
sentences.english: I play it three times a week , and sometimes more !
sentences.chinese: 我每周玩三次，有时甚至更多！

sentences.content: There is a ping-pong bat here.
sentences.english: There is a ping-pong bat here

sentences.content: Is it yours? No, it isn’t mine. Is it Ella’s?
sentences.english: Is it yours ? No , it isn't mine . Is it Ella's ?
sentences.chinese: 这是你的吗？不，这不是我的。这是Ella的吗？

sentences.content: Hi, Yaming! Is this your bat?
sentences.english: Hi , Yaming ! Is this your bat ?

sentences.chinese: 你的球棒看起来用得很顺手。

wordDetails.definition: look（第三人称单数现在时）: 看起来

sentences.content: Yes, twice a week, and sometimes more!
sentences.english: Yes , twice a week , and sometimes more !
sentences.chinese: 是的，每周两次，有时甚至更多！

sentences.content: I seldom do, but I often play badminton.
sentences.english: I seldom do , but I often play badminton
sentences.chinese: 我很少这样做，但我经常打羽毛球。

sentences.content: I sometimes play badminton with Ella.
sentences.english: I sometimes play badminton with Ella
sentences.chinese: 我有时会和Ella一起打羽毛球。

sentences.content: We should all play doubles sometime!
sentences.english: We should all play doubles sometime !
sentences.chinese: 我们改天应该一起打双打！
